_note: 學習路徑內容第23批 #5／6：擴充字彙──環境與學習主題（eng.t_mid.vocab.expand-2000，會考級／中階，逾會考 1200 基準、銜接學測）。注意：vocab.expand-2000 是『字彙廣度／擴充』型 KP，無法由單一單元承載全部字；本單元取一組具代表性的擴充字（protect／pollution／recycle／reduce／improve）做環境與學習主題字彙單元，以『字義在情境中正確運用』方式練習、exercise 此 KP。can_do／title 誠實標示為『一組擴充字』，不宣稱精熟全部 2000 字。誘答鎖『以情境語意唯一判定、選項字義彼此明顯不同（含反義 increase）』避免近義詞第二正解。字義依 Cambridge／Oxford 詞典，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix xvb_）。

units.title_zh: 擴充字彙（環境與學習主題）
units.can_do: 我能在情境中運用一組會考高標、銜接學測的擴充字（環境保護與學習主題，如 protect／pollution／recycle／reduce／improve）。
units.situation_group: 字彙：擴充字（環境與學習主題）
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'protect' is a verb meaning to keep someone or something safe from harm: 'We should protect wild animals.'
claims.verification_ref: protect＝保護、使免於傷害（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'pollution' is a noun meaning harmful materials that make air, water or land dirty: 'Air pollution is bad for our health.'
claims.verification_ref: pollution＝污染、使空氣／水／土地變髒的有害物質（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'recycle' is a verb meaning to treat used things such as paper, cans and bottles so that they can be used again: 'We recycle paper and bottles.'
claims.verification_ref: recycle＝回收、把用過的東西處理成可再利用（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'reduce' means to make something smaller in amount or size; 'improve' means to make something better: 'reduce waste' / 'improve your health.'
claims.verification_ref: reduce＝減少（數量）、improve＝改善／使變好（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: This unit expands your words for the environment and learning. 'protect' means to keep something safe from harm: We should protect the forest. A bigger vocabulary helps you read harder texts.
teach.zh_hint: 這個單元擴充你在環境與學習主題的字彙。protect＝保護，使某物免於傷害：We should protect the forest.（我們應該保護森林。）字量擴充能讀懂較難的文章。

teach.body: We must protect wild animals and their homes.
teach.zh_hint: 我們必須保護野生動物和牠們的家。protect＝保護。

teach.body: 'pollution' means dirty, harmful materials in the air, water, or land; 'recycle' means to treat used things so they can be used again. Air pollution is bad for us. We recycle bottles.
teach.zh_hint: pollution＝污染，空氣、水或土地中的髒污有害物質；recycle＝回收，把用過的東西處理成可再利用。Air pollution is bad for us.（空氣污染對我們有害。）We recycle bottles.（我們回收瓶子。）

teach.body: We recycle cans and bottles to reduce pollution.
teach.zh_hint: 我們回收罐子和瓶子以減少污染。recycle＝回收、pollution＝污染。

teach.body: 'reduce' means to make an amount smaller; 'improve' means to make something better. We can reduce waste and improve our city.
teach.zh_hint: reduce＝減少數量；improve＝改善、使某物變好。We can reduce waste and improve our city.（我們可以減少垃圾、改善我們的城市。）

teach.body: Riding a bike can reduce pollution and improve your health.
teach.zh_hint: 騎腳踏車能減少污染並改善健康。reduce＝減少、improve＝改善。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：Sunscreen can ____ your skin from the strong sunlight.（保護皮膚）

distractor_rationales.pollute: pollute 是『污染』，與保護皮膚相反。
distractor_rationales.break: break 是『弄壞』，與保護相反。

practice.feedback: protect your skin from sunlight：protect＝保護、使免於傷害。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：Dirty smoke from cars causes air ____.（空氣污染）

distractor_rationales.education: education 是『教育』，與髒空氣無關。

practice.feedback: dirty smoke causes air pollution：pollution＝污染。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：Don't throw away these glass bottles; we can ____ them into new ones.（回收再利用，製成新瓶子）

distractor_rationales.pollute: pollute 是『污染』，不能把瓶子『污染成新瓶子』，語意不對。

practice.feedback: we can recycle them into new ones：recycle＝回收、處理成可再利用。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：Turning off the lights helps ____ the use of electricity.（減少用電）

distractor_rationales.increase: increase 是『增加』，與『關燈省電』相反。

practice.feedback: turning off the lights → reduce the use of electricity（減少）。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：If you practice every day, your English will ____.（進步、變好）

distractor_rationales.destroy: destroy 是『破壞、摧毀』，與進步相反。
distractor_rationales.forget: forget 是『忘記』，與英文變好相反。

practice.feedback: practice every day → your English will improve（改善、變好）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We recycle paper and bottles to protect the environment.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：recycle、paper and bottles、protect the environment、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。主題字重讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: We should protect the environment together.
lines.intonation: protect 重讀、together 句尾下收

lines.text: Recycling can reduce pollution in our city.
lines.intonation: reduce pollution 連讀、city 句尾下收
